ELECTRICITY — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

3. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.

   B. Keyboard
